current.text: A Pelicans beat reporter expects Missi to start at center over Derik Queen.
The experts expect Missi to be the Pelicans' starting center on opening night, ahead of Derik Queen, who does not fit well next to Zion Williamson.
Josh sees two-block upside, high FG% and double-digit rebounds. He calls Missi worth a flier around pick 120.
The Pelicans have too many players for 240 minutes. Derik Queen, Zion Williamson and Saddiq Bey all compete for frontcourt minutes, and lineups with Zion at center and Bey may close games.
New coach Jamahl Mosley brings a defense-first identity and switches less than the previous coach.
Less switching under Mosley could help Missi's defensive rebounding.
The Pelicans are projected as a weak team, around 34 wins and out of the playoffs.

durable.text: His shot blocking and rim protection improved a lot last season. He contests shots at the rim at a high rate and turned 39% of rim contests into blocks.
He is a poor defensive rebounder for a center, around the bottom 10% at his position.
Blocks are his standout category, far above the top 250 pool. He makes no threes and gets very few steals.

note: Missi is a late flier at 0 USD on both Yahoo and ESPN (Yahoo rank 131, ESPN rank 165), and he went for 2 USD in our league last season, so he should cost 1 to 2 USD at the end of the auction. He is a block source for punt 3PM or punt STL builds, with about 1.8 blocks projected and good FG%. Early in the season, check that he starts over Derik Queen and plays 25 or more minutes. Also check his FT%: Yahoo projects 69.4%, but he shot 55.9% last season.
